key_findings: Nociceptor-derived CGRP acts on Calcrl/RAMP1 on synovial macrophages to suppress arthritis inflammation; chronic activation downregulates Calcrl.
Calcrl overexpression in macrophages alleviated joint inflammation without intensifying pain.
